name: notion-search
title: Search Notion and connected sources
description: Perform a search over your entire Notion workspace and connected sources (Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Jira, and more). Use it to find pages, databases, and their content by keyword or natural-language question. Search results include page titles, URLs, and short highlights.

query.description: Semantic search query over your entire Notion workspace and connected sources.

query_type.description: Use 'user' to search for workspace members instead of content.

data_source_url.description: Optionally, provide the URL of a data source to restrict the search to it.

filters.description: Optional filters such as created date range or creator.

name: notion-fetch
title: Fetch Notion entities
description: Retrieves details about a Notion entity (page, database, or data source) by URL or ID. Returns the page content in Notion-flavored Markdown, along with its properties.

id.description: The ID or URL of the Notion page, database, or data source to fetch.

name: notion-create-pages
title: Create pages in Notion
description: Creates one or more Notion pages with the specified properties and content. Pages can be created under a parent page, a data source (database), or as private workspace pages.

pages.description: The pages to create, each with properties and content in Notion-flavored Markdown.

parent.description: The parent under which the new pages will be created: a page ID or data source ID.

name: notion-update-page
title: Update Notion page
description: Update a Notion page's properties or content. Supports replacing all content, inserting content after a selection, or updating properties.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to update.

command.description: One of update_properties, replace_content, replace_content_range, insert_content_after.

new_str.description: The new content in Notion-flavored Markdown.

name: notion-move-pages
title: Move Notion pages
description: Move one or more Notion pages or databases to a new parent.

page_or_database_ids.description: IDs of the pages or databases to move.

new_parent.description: The new parent page, database, or workspace.

name: notion-duplicate-page
title: Duplicate Notion page
description: Duplicate a Notion page. The page must be within the current workspace. Duplication completes asynchronously.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to duplicate.

name: notion-create-database
title: Create Notion database
description: Creates a new Notion database with the specified properties schema, as a child page of a parent or in the workspace.

title.description: The title of the new database.

properties.description: The property schema of the database: column names and types.

parent.description: The parent page under which to create the database.

name: notion-update-database
title: Update Notion database
description: Update a Notion database's title, description, or property schema: add, rename, or remove columns.

database_id.description: The ID of the database to update.

name: notion-query-data-sources
title: Query Notion data sources
description: Query a Notion data source (database) with filters and sorts to retrieve the rows that match, like a SQL SELECT over a database.

data_source_url.description: The URL of the data source to query.

name: notion-create-comment
title: Add comment to page
description: Add a comment to a page or to a specific block of content in a Notion page.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to comment on.

rich_text.description: The comment text as rich text.

discussion_id.description: Reply in an existing discussion thread.

name: notion-get-comments
title: Get comments
description: Get all comments and discussion threads on a Notion page.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to get comments from.

name: notion-get-users
title: List workspace users
description: Retrieves a list of users in the current Notion workspace, with names and emails.

query.description: Filter users by name or email.

user_id.description: Return a single user by ID, or 'self' for the current user.

name: notion-get-teams
title: List teamspaces
description: Retrieves a list of teams (teamspaces) in the current Notion workspace.

name: notion-get-self
title: Get bot user
description: Retrieve your token's bot user and the workspace it belongs to.
